async function haveFiveRawIronIntoIronIngots(bot) {
    // The function checks if the player has at least five iron ingots; if so, it succeeds immediately. Otherwise, it determines how many more ingots are needed. It verifies that enough raw iron is present to meet the requirement. If a furnace is not found nearby, it attempts to place one. It then searches for a suitable fuel source, such as coal or wood planks. Finally, it smelts the necessary raw iron using the found fuel to reach the target ingot count.
}
